nodes.label: Redirect URL /restablecer-contrasena
nodes.rationale: Without registering the redirect URL the email link goes to the Site URL instead of the new-password screen and the flow does not close.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth config (Confirm email off, redirect URLs)
nodes.norm_label: supabase auth config (confirm email off, redirect urls)

nodes.label: Reservas (savings pocket with compound daily interest)
nodes.norm_label: reservas (savings pocket with compound daily interest)

nodes.label: Balance operations only via SECURITY DEFINER RPC
nodes.norm_label: balance operations only via security definer rpc
nodes.rationale: RPCs with search_path='' and FOR UPDATE are the only way to modify third-party accounts atomically; include per-user rate limiting (private.enforce_rate).

nodes.label: Edge Function qr-lectura
nodes.rationale: Deployed with --no-verify-jwt because other banks have no users in Monix Supabase.

nodes.label: QR de un solo uso (section 13)
nodes.rationale: Like a posnet: QR closes on first scan; jti becomes mandatory for closure and reader waits up to 3s instead of fire-and-forget.

nodes.label: Prompt: aviso de lectura y QR de un solo uso for Banco Tuo
nodes.norm_label: prompt: aviso de lectura y qr de un solo uso for banco tuo

nodes.label: Reader waits max 3s, never blocks payment
nodes.norm_label: reader waits max 3s, never blocks payment
nodes.rationale: A bank being down must never block a payment; only 409 prevents paying.

nodes.label: Unsigned aviso rationale
nodes.rationale: Avoids key exchange: the signed qr proves existence/validity; a forged aviso moves no money, only shows a message or closes a QR.

nodes.label: JWT firmado ES256 (iss, cbu, alias, monto, moneda, iat, exp)
nodes.norm_label: jwt firmado es256 (iss, cbu, alias, monto, moneda, iat, exp)

nodes.label: Manual public key (JWK) distribution
nodes.rationale: No autodiscovery; each team hardcodes bankCode, kid, publicKeyJwk.

nodes.label: Compatibility fallback (JWT, unknown iss, plain JSON, MONIXQR:/MONIXPAY:)
nodes.norm_label: compatibility fallback (jwt, unknown iss, plain json, monixqr:/monixpay:)
nodes.rationale: Ordered fallbacks so banks that did not implement the spec keep working.

nodes.label: Google Fonts Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter
nodes.norm_label: google fonts plus jakarta sans + inter

nodes.label: /bc-api same-origin proxy
nodes.rationale: The Banco Central API sends no CORS headers, so the browser must call a same-origin proxy (vite.config.ts in dev, vercel.json rewrite in prod).

nodes.label: Dark mode without flash
nodes.rationale: Inline script in index.html reads localStorage and applies the dark class before React mounts, avoiding the white flash.

nodes.label: PDF comprobante via html2canvas + jsPDF
nodes.rationale: Capturing real HTML guarantees the PDF uses Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter instead of jsPDF native fonts.

nodes.label: Cuentas_Bancarias (id_cuenta, id_producto, cbu, alias, moneda, saldo)
nodes.norm_label: cuentas_bancarias (id_cuenta, id_producto, cbu, alias, moneda, saldo)

nodes.label: Personas (id, nombre, apellido, dni, direccion, email, telefono, fecha_nac)
nodes.norm_label: personas (id, nombre, apellido, dni, direccion, email, telefono, fecha_nac)

nodes.label: Tarjetas_Credito (id_tarjeta, id_producto, numero, marca, fecha_vencimiento, limite, dia_cierre)
nodes.norm_label: tarjetas_credito (id_tarjeta, id_producto, numero, marca, fecha_vencimiento, limite, dia_cierre)

nodes.label: Metas comunes (shared goals with majority vote)
nodes.norm_label: metas comunes (shared goals with majority vote)

nodes.label: QrPanels 5s incoming-transfer sync
nodes.rationale: When the reader pays via transfer the internal cobro never becomes paid, so QrPanels polls incoming transfers every 5s and shows Pago recibido on a matching amount.

nodes.label: Internal vs external transfers
nodes.rationale: Monix->Monix transfers are processed locally in Supabase; external ones go through the Banco Central API and incoming ones are detected by polling every 2 minutes.

nodes.label: operacion_id idempotent transfer
nodes.rationale: Each transfer is registered first in the Banco Central; operacion_id with a unique index ensures a retry does not resend to BC and the RPC debits once.

nodes.label: Composite descripcion Motivo|Mensaje
nodes.rationale: Stores motivo and optional mensaje in one column to avoid an extra column; parsed at every display point.

nodes.label: Single Realtime channel per cuenta (ref counting)
nodes.norm_label: single realtime channel per cuenta (ref counting)
nodes.rationale: App and each page mount useCuenta; sharing the channel by cuenta.id with reference counting avoids supabase-js crashing on a second postgres_changes listener.
